title: The Influence of Postoperative Postures on Persistent Sub-foveal Fluid After Scleral Buckle Surgery
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate whether postoperative postures influence persistent sub-foveal fluid after scleral buckle surgery
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD)
* macula off
* treated by successful scleral buckle surgery
* recent onset with symptom within 1 month

Exclusion Criteria:

* with failed previous surgery
* intraoperative or postoperative injection of long-acting gas
* with other eye diseases than RRD
